issue.description:
## Scope
Test checkpoint suppression, failure, recovery, sharded restore, and monolithic restore scenarios.

## Tasks
- Write tests for checkpoint suppression (--no-auto-flush)
- Write tests for checkpoint failure and recovery
- Write tests for sharded checkpoint restore
- Write tests for monolithic checkpoint restore
- Test recovery from corrupted/incomplete checkpoints
- Verify old/new fixture compatibility across all scenarios

## Acceptance
- tests/recovery.rs covers all checkpoint failure/recovery scenarios
- Checkpoint suppression tests verify data stays in database only
- Checkpoint failure tests simulate write failures and verify recovery
- Sharded restore tests correctly reassemble from multiple files
- Monolithic restore tests correctly load from single file
- Recovery from corrupted checkpoints is graceful and data-safe
- Old fixtures work with new binary and vice versa where compatible
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test pass
issue.title: Implement recovery conformance tests for checkpoint scenarios

issue.description:
ADR-004 requires a bead-rs-ci lane running `cargo +1.85 check --all-targets` on every CI run so the declared Rust 1.85 floor is tested rather than asserted, and requires the lane's pinned toolchain to equal the manifest's rust-version with any drift treated as a CI failure. No open bead tracks this lane; the only open CI bead is the arch-suffixed release binary (beadrs-778fbff1). Work: add the pinned-toolchain step to the bead-rs-ci WorkflowTemplate in declarative-config k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows, assert toolchain-vs-manifest version equality inside the lane, and record the lane's first green run as evidence on the bead.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add the pinned MSRV verification lane (cargo +1.85 check) to bead-rs-ci per ADR-004

issue.description:
ADR-005 records as a drawback that a deliberately parked, assigned issue is indistinguishable at the schema level from residue left by a worker that moved on, so a legitimate reservation warns on every doctor run and trains operators to ignore the ready_frontier warning. Add an explicit opt-in marker (e.g. an update flag) that records an assignment as intentional, suppresses the ready_frontier warning for that issue only, is visible in show/list output, and survives checkpoint round trips and reopen. Default behavior for unmarked assignments and all existing diagnostics stay unchanged.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Provide a way to mark an assignment as intentionally held (ADR-005 drawback)
